phase1_subchains.name: Theta Subchain Deployment
features: 6 subchains (1 per circuit) with unique IDs 361001-361006
Validator collateral: 1,000 wTHETA + 20,000 TFUEL per validator
<2s block finality on subchains
Isolation configs: separate state, independent pause, dedicated validators
Cross-chain relay via ZKVerifierSP1 for main ↔ subchain messaging
7 new smoke tests for subchain configuration

phase2_rollup.name: ZK Rollup Layer (SP1 Recursion)
features: settleRollupBatch(): Recursive SP1 proof aggregation for batch settlement
verifyRecursiveProof(): Multi-level recursion (depth 1-8)
Recursive nullifier tracking with parent chain verification
Merkle root computation for batch commitment
RollupSettled event with amortized gas metrics
RecursiveProofVerified event with depth tracking
getRollupStats() / getRollupBatch() / getRecursiveNullifier() views

phase3_depin.name: Cross-DePIN Routing
features: ChainType.DEPIN for DePIN network routing
Render Network chain configuration (GPU: A100/H100/RTX4090)
Akash GPU Marketplace chain configuration (reverse-auction, SDL v2.0)
7 new cross-chain routes for DEPIN (EVM↔DEPIN, COSMOS↔DEPIN, SVM↔DEPIN, DEPIN↔DEPIN)
DePIN provider registry with status tracking
selectDePINProvider(): GPU-aware, price-sorted provider selection
findMultiHopRoute(): Multi-hop routing with gas budget constraints

phase4_intents.name: Intent-Based Architecture
features: IntentOutcomeType: fulfilled, partial, failed, no_path, timeout, deferred
DePINProviderStatus: available, busy, offline, bidding
Outcome-driven dispatch with automatic resolution
No-path solving via multi-hop route discovery
Pending intent tracking with configurable timeouts
Intent timeout detection and resolution
Per-outcome metrics in getStatus()

phase6_x402.name: x402 v3 Integration
features: createEscrow(): Pay-up-to caps with payer/payee tracking
claimEscrow(): 1% protocol fee deduction, remainder refund to payer
refundEscrow(): Automatic refund after expiry
createDeferredClaim(): Delay-gated claims linked to ZK proof nullifiers
executeDeferredClaim(): Post-delay execution with protocol fee
getX402Stats(): Escrowed/claimed/refunded/active counts
EscrowCreated/EscrowClaimed/EscrowRefunded/DeferredClaimCreated/DeferredClaimExecuted events

compatibility.tao_subnet: Compatible — escrow/claim for dTAO staked compute tasks
compatibility.hyperlane: Compatible — cross-chain escrow relay via dispatch
compatibility.a2a_circuit: Direct integration — agent micropayments via escrow

security_notes.recursive_nullifiers: Every inner proof nullifier is tracked with parent chain, preventing replay across batch boundaries
security_notes.circuit_breaker: Inherited 5% failure rate threshold applies to recursive proofs
security_notes.pay_up_to: Claim amount capped by maxAmount, excess refunded to payer
